content.text:
This is a topographic map of a real place (Breakneck Ridge, New York), drawn in the style of a USGS 7.5-minute quadrangle. The contour interval is 20 meters, index contours (heavy brown lines, some labeled) are every 100 meters, and elevations are in meters. Rescue carry: a stretcher team carries a casualty along the Quarry Trail (dashed red line) from the magenta square S to the magenta square E. To pace the carry, the team leader logs every contour line the trail crosses. How many contour lines (index contours included) does the trail cross between S and E? If it crosses the same contour line more than once, count every crossing. Answer with a whole number, for example 7.

Think step by step. Then end your reply with one final line in exactly this form:
FINAL ANSWER: <your answer>

message.content:
Tracing the Quarry Trail from S to E and counting each contour crossing, including index contours and any repeated crossings, gives 12.

FINAL ANSWER: 12
